title: Descant Recorder
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 9 Creative Arts and Sports; not yet checked by a CBC Creative Arts and Sports teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Read the fingering chart for the class recorders (Baroque or German) before teaching B flat.

skills.key_step: The child says the F major scale is F G A B-flat C D E F, low F uses both hands, B flat has a cross-fingering, and the flat in the key signature applies to every B.
representations: an F major scale on the staff
steps: Check the key signature: one flat.
Play low F gently with both hands.
Use the cross-fingering for B flat.
Go up to F and back.
contexts: an F major solo for a concert

board.do: Point at the flat on the middle line.

misconceptions.ask: How do you play B flat on the recorder?
misconceptions.repair: Play B, then B flat with the cross-fingering; hear the difference.

misconceptions.ask: Does low F need the right hand?
misconceptions.repair: Play low F slowly, covering the right-hand holes.

misconceptions.ask: A piece in F major has a B on the middle line. What do you play?
How should you blow for low F?
misconceptions.repair: Play low F gently and then hard.

checks.question: Which note in F major has a special cross-fingering?
Does low F need the right hand?
